                     ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE SAFETY

  Mr. ROUNDS. Mr. President, I rise today to speak about the future of
artificial intelligence. Experts in the field tell us that artificial
general intelligence may arrive within this decade. We are not
prepared for systems that could match or exceed human capabilities
across the board. If we lose control of a superintelligent system,
there is no second chance.
  The PRESIDING OFFICER. The Senator from South Dakota has the floor.
  Mr. ROUNDS. Thank you. As I was saying, recursive self-improvement
is no longer science fiction.
  Ms. CANTWELL of Washington. Will the Senator yield for a question?
I share the concern about AGI, but I want to focus on the near-term
harms of these AI systems as well.
  Mr. ROUNDS. I yield to the Senator from Washington.
